springBoot.checkPropertyValues.title: Warn about values that do not match the key type
springBoot.checkPropertyValues.description: Validates literal configuration values against declared metadata types; environment/profile/import precedence and runtime values are unresolved.

springBoot.checkMetadataFiles.title: Check (additional-)spring-configuration-metadata.json files (shape, defaults, deprecation, hints, project classes)
springBoot.checkMetadataFiles.description: Checks metadata source shape/default declarations/hints. Declared defaults are static metadata, not effective application values.

springBoot.checkDriverDependency.title: Hint when a spring.datasource.url names a JDBC driver the build files do not declare (transitive drivers are not seen)
springBoot.checkDriverDependency.description: Uses explicit build declarations only; transitive/effective drivers are unknown. No database connection is opened.

springBoot.nativeRunProfiles.title: Offer native Boot Maven/Gradle run profiles
springBoot.nativeRunProfiles.description: Discovery reads direct Boot build plugin declarations. Selecting Run executes the project build using the explicitly granted system mvn/gradle executable. Project plugins and build logic can execute. No wrapper, automatic execution or debugger attach is supplied.
